name: intrusion
description: Fail-closed public ingress monitoring and containment: operator-owned routes, local detection, gateway proxying, evidence, notification, and Cloudflare tunnel cutoff.
cardTemplate: Summarise the intrusion domain: trusted Cloudflare ingress, deterministic local detection, immediate connection cutoff, durable incident state, remote tunnel containment, and explicit recovery.
rationale: Intrusion protection coordinates the local public gateway and Cloudflare containment across several infrastructure boundaries, while keeping its fail-closed policy and recovery lifecycle independently owned. Tests also belong to the cross-cutting test-environment domain.
